archetypes.name: dyn-scout-gate
archetypes.rationale: Step 5 now gates dynamic reviewers on coder-produced manifests.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the implement Step 5 dispatch path for accidental fall-through into the legacy dynamic scout. Check missing, invalid, intentionally empty, and filtered-to-zero producer sidecars. Verify warning dedupe and status propagation stay consistent across review_and_fix and review_pipeline. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-summary-line
archetypes.rationale: Final summaries now report dynamic-archetype provenance.
archetypes.prompt_body: Check the implement and design final-summary dynamic-archetype lines for stale sidecar handling and accurate static-only wording. Verify the shared run-summary renderer remains backward compatible when no dynamic line is passed. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
